 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-55327  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Arts, Culture, and Tourism
  Committee meeting of Tuesday, June 4, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-55326  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation related to the expansion of the
  Percent for the Arts Program to boost support for public art installations, local
  artists, and live music; and, if appropriate, provide feedback to department staff on

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-55329  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on updates related to the

  and Paralympic Games.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 Opportunity to address the Arts, Culture, and Tourism Committee on non-agenda items. Each
 speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
